title: 10 Euro Silver Aufbrezeln – Leather Coin SU
descriptionPlain: No other item of clothing symbolises Austrian culture and identity quite like a pair of lederhosen. With elegance and timeless appeal, each pair is unique, preserving memories and telling stories of the inseparable connection between people and nature. Originally designed to withstand the harsh mountain climate and the physical demands of work in forestry and agriculture, lederhosen are made from sturdy deer or chamois leather. Historically, they were a reliable companion that often lasted a lifetime and were passed down through the generations. Today, decorations fashioned from elaborate embroidery featuring animal and plant motifs adorn many lederhosen, symbolising a deep connection to nature, resilience and regional pride.Whether worn at folk festivals, family gatherings or in everyday life, lederhosen connect the past, present and future. A man wearing intricately embroidered lederhosen and other traditional attire is shown seated on the coin’s reverse. His hat, clothing and walking stick are colour-printed. A horizontal decorative band with a stag motif adorns the background. The coin’s obverse features tools and products used in leatherworking. In the background on the left, a section of a traditional belt with quill embroidery runs horizontally, in front of which stands a stitching awl.The dexterity, patience and expertise of the lederhosen maker turn every pair of lederhosen into a work of art. Yet the enduring tradition of lederhosen not only stems from their artisanship but also from what they stand for – a little piece of home, a sign of quality and an expression of a lifestyle that values craftsmanship and authenticity. Whether as an heirloom, a fashionable highlight or faithful everyday companion, lederhosen stand for values that never go out of fashion.
